question: By whose grace does the speaker claim to have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
Knowledge of the Kaula determination is claimed by the speaker.
That knowledge is attributed to the grace of the addressed lord.
inference: By the grace of the lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the Kaula determination.
uncertainties: The mode by which grace produces knowledge is not specified here.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the Kaula determination.
